text_block_list.text:
“—Ever since Chairwoman Akikawa's announcement,
there was a never-ending stream of students
and Trainers around the field.”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, this is some impressive soil.
Grandpa would be truly amazed if he saw this, nya.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it really that amazing?
This dirt?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I guess only someone with farming in their blood would understand.
Not too heavy, not too light, packed with organic matter.
Sei-chan can tell good soil just by looking at it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It must have taken a tremendous amount of work
to make soil like this.
And you're doing it without pesticides, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The Chairwoman was taking care of a field this big
all by herself until now, wasn't she...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: (...Was that really just a dream?)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
(All the efforts poured into the students' nourishment...
Could the Three Goddesses have worked a miracle to reward them...?)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
(...No answer will come from overthinking it.
In any case—)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: (The fate of the academy's food! I pray the Three Goddesses watch over us!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, everyone!
Feast your eyes to your heart's content!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Right now, I'm giving away our previous harvest! Whether you're a student starting your own vegetable garden or not, take as much as you like!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Rice is interested in
growing vegetables too, though...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if someone like me...
can really raise these veggies properly...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Come on! Give it a shot and it'll work out somehow!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to farming, working together
makes you a hundred times stronger.
You don't have to do everything alone, ya know?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We used to help out at home, after all!
If there's anything you don't know, we can teach you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? B-But... are you sure you want Rice?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Besides, I can smell a kindred spirit
in Rice-san!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-What's up?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san's expression back then...
The glint in her eyes after stuffing her cheeks with veggies—
I just knew it! She was thinking the exact same thing as me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"If only I could eat, eat, and gorge on such delicious veggies to my heart's content..."
That's the look they had in their eyes!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, th-that was the case, but...
D-Don't say it out loud~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, that's great!
When it comes to farm work, loving vegetables is
the best talent you could ask for.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Running into each other here is fate, isn't it?
Why don't we tend the fields together?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's got their eyes on the fields right now.
If we're doing this, we might as well grow
the absolute best veggies out there, don'tcha think?!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...!
I'm looking forward to working with you...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yay! The Full Belly Alliance is officially formed!

Hey, hey! We want to
join that alliance too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "I-I was really moved back then too... I had no idea vegetables could be this delicious."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And so, I thought to myself: since it's such an amazing
vegetable, if possible... I'd love to cook it
in the most delicious way possible.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! The more you make and the more you cook, the more "buono" everyone will be!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
U-Um~...
For example, what kind of dishes can you make!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well, you see~☆ There's curry, sandwiches, pot-au-feu, extra garlic ramen, and more~

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Vegetable pizza, Mapo Tofu with chili peppers... Anyway, I think there are plenty of possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oooh...! *drool*...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-That sounds so nice...!
Rice can't help but dream big...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Once the vegetables are ripe, maybe we could all try cooking different things with them.
Like a little tasting party.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A tasting session...!
I-I want to do it! Rice wants to try!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm fired up!
From here on, we're gonna grow veggies non-stop!
And turn every last one of 'em into delicious dishes!

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Ooh!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Till the land well, nurture them well, and eat—grow
up strong and healthy, just like these bountiful vegetables!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Right then!
Time for me to work up a sweat too!
